commits.message:
Merge pull request #26 from jobfynder-admin/dev

Dev

feat(resume-builder): wire credits and sharing to the real backend

- Credits: live balance (GET /api/billing/credits/me) in the builder nav
  and modal; real top-up packs (GET /api/billing/topups/packs); the cost
  table now mirrors the backend's CREDIT_COSTS. Removes the hard-coded
  "47 credits", static packs and the invented "25 on signup" claim. The
  purchase button is disabled until Stripe checkout is wired.
- Sharing: replaces the mock "Invite collaborators" modal with real share
  links (create/copy/revoke, view or comment) backed by
  /api/collaboration, plus a public /shared/resume/:token page with
  read-only resume and comments (noindex).
- Removes the now-unused mock constants.

Requires the BE branch that restores billing/credits/collaboration/variants.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(resume-builder): remove fake data and mock CTAs, wire bench roster

- New resumes start blank. The builder used to start from a sample
  "Alex Johnson / Citi" resume and autosave it, and empty server fields were
  refilled from it on every load.
- Summary "Generate with AI" now calls the real suggestion endpoint using the
  user's own headline/experience/skills; Skills "Generate"/"Suggest missing"
  (which injected Kafka/Terraform/GraphQL) and the no-op "Reorder" are removed.
  Dry-run placeholders from Hermes are rejected instead of shown.
- Removes hard-coded "Verified/Endorsed" badges from the preview and the mock
  variant dropdown in the nav (now shows the real resume name).
- Bench-sales dashboard reads the real managed-consultant roster; delete calls
  the API; fake base-resume/variant/tailor/blind-resume/edit modals and mock
  alerts/health panel are removed. Resume columns read "none" until resumes
  are linked to managed consultants in the backend.
- Removes the mock Tailor action from consultant My Resumes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(resume-builder): real export (PDF/DOCX/TXT) and Save to Documents

- Export now generates a text-based PDF, DOCX or plain text in the browser
  from the resume data; the old menu had no handlers.
- 'Save to my Documents' uploads the PDF through the documents module
  (presigned quarantine upload, scan, versioning) and links it to the resume
  (PUT /resume/:id/document); saving again adds a new version.
- Replaces the Actions menu with a Share button and removes the mock
  Marketing modal.
- Adds service clients for documents, achievements, feedback, endorsements,
  bench summary.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(resume-builder): real Achievement Library, Feedback, Tailor to Job, bench dashboard

- Achievement Library: persisted per user / bench consultant (CRUD, search,
  role filter, insert into resume with usage counting, AI-drafted bullet that
  the user reviews before saving). Removes the sample achievements.
- Feedback: persisted AI analysis of the saved resume, owner notes,
  applied/ignored states, apply-to-summary, and skill endorsements given
  through share links (public endorse UI on the shared page).
- Tailor to Job: only real match data (score, breakdown, matched/missing
  skills, risks), tailoring opportunities, job-specific summary, and save as a
  job-specific variant. Removes the fabricated interview-likelihood/benchmark
  panels and the job-source tiles that all fed the same text box.
- ATS check runs on request (it is credit-gated; it used to re-run on every
  keystroke) and saves the score to the resume.
- Bench sales dashboard: per-consultant resume list/builder scoped by
  consultantProfileId; counts, ATS score and status come from
  GET /resume/bench-summary.
- Prunes the now-unused mock constants, types and the track-outcome modal.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(resume-builder): tolerate loosely-shaped saved resumes

Resumes saved by the upload / LinkedIn import paths store experience,
education and certifications in a different shape (no bullets array,
certifications as plain strings). Opening one crashed the preview with
"Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'filter')" and the error
boundary reset the page. Everything read from the server is now normalised
into the builder's shape (fromResumeRecord).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(resume-builder): Stripe checkout for credit top-ups

Credit packs can now be bought in the credits dialog with Stripe's Payment
Element (card data goes straight to Stripe). Offered only when
VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY is set; otherwise the dialog says checkout is not
enabled. After payment the balance is re-read while the webhook grants credits.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(resume-builder): LinkedIn import and more AI assist

- LinkedIn import: the dialog now calls core's LinkedIn import (via the new
  POST /api/resume/import/linkedin), previews what was found, and either fills
  only empty sections or replaces, in the builder; from My Resumes it creates a
  new resume. It used to show a fake success toast.
- AI assist where it was missing: per-role 'Improve with AI' and 'Suggest
  bullets' (reviewed before applying), 'Suggest a headline', and 'Suggest from
  my experience' for skills (candidate terms checked against the skills
  taxonomy, so nothing is invented).
- Fixes the skills editor showing sample skills (Java, Spring Boot, React...)
  for every resume, and hiding a saved flat skills list that has no categories.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(resume-builder): contain Stripe checkout failures inside the dialog

An invalid publishable key or client secret made Stripe.js throw during render
and took the whole page down. The checkout now has its own error boundary and
a Payment Element load-error handler. Found by running the flow against a local
Stripe mock.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(resume-builder): AI assists against live Hermes

Found by running them through UAT: a request with no target role was blocked
by Hermes and shown as 'AI not enabled'. A default role is now sent, a blocked
run reads as an error, fenced JSON answers (including accomplishment_bullets)
are unwrapped, and the headline suggestion keeps one short sentence.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(resume-builder): skip job-level words in skill suggestions

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(resume-builder): install ATS v1 template in the Templates tab

Real template switcher, live server-rendered preview with ATS text view, lint panel,
page-count badge, trim-assistant disclosure, and server-side PDF/DOCX/TXT export.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(resume-builder): ATS v1 role fields, keyword panel, contact override

- experience: end client, employment type, environment line
- Tailor to a job: keyword coverage with confirm-before-add actions and saved target
- contact override on export, PDF-unavailable note, on-screen preview margins

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(resume-builder): checks tab, live editing in the preview, real-time sharing

- One Checks tab: readiness status, Fix buttons that open the exact field, a submission checklist,
  job-posting match and the AI review folded in. The old ATS Check and the template checks are merged.
- Edit text right on the ATS preview (click a line and type); other parts jump to their form.
  Fit-to-width page with approximate page breaks.
- Section nav shows open problems per section and who is working where.
- Share dialog in the Google-Docs style (people by email with roles, link access), live presence,
  coloured field markers, view-only mode and a Shared with me list.
- Live editing merges per field (Yjs); unit tests cover the merge rules.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(resume-builder): comments, history, locks, job intake, simpler dashboards, bullet numbers

- Comments tab: field-anchored threads, reply, resolve, live updates, bubbles on commented fields.
- History tab: named versions with restore, owner section locks, activity trail; per-section 'edited by'.
- Job Match and Tailor to Job share one job, added through option cards (paste, LinkedIn Jobs, Dice,
  careers page, LinkedIn feed, manual). Removed the fake 'rank variants' and local-only 'save version'.
- Consultant dashboard: one toolbar and list, delete asks first. Bench dashboard: Open button, overview modal removed.
- Optional number per bullet; live editing pauses on idle and resumes on activity.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(resume-builder): keep the field of study when loading an imported education entry

The builder has a single degree line and took "degree" first, so an imported "B.S." +
"Computer Science" lost the field. Join them as "B.S. in Computer Science" (without repeating
a field the degree already names) and add tests.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(resume-builder): share token in a header, comment ownership flag, paged lists

- Send the share link token in X-Share-Token instead of the URL (document, autosave, comments, history, versions).
- Comments carry `mine` from the server (no account ids any more); delete buttons use it.
- Comments load page by page; "Shared with me" shows the newest page with a "Show more" button.
- Retry joining a live room when another API instance owns it or it is full; clear message when a change is
  refused for size.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Resume builder: AI tools in Job Match (tailor, gaps, cover letter), headline suggestions, remove dead mock UI

- JobAiAssistant with tick-to-apply and flags; HeadlineAiAssist uses the headline prompt
- Credits table matches backend prices (rule-based features 1 credit)
- Remove unreferenced mock collaboration/approval components and unused service functions

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Resume builder: send expectedUpdatedAt on saves, stop autosave on 409, score stored by the server

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Resume builder: send resumeId on the live-editing handshake (sticky routing); read 409 from the API client's error shape

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge branch 'dev' into dev-duplicate

Bring dev-duplicate up to date with the latest dev.
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/resume-builder/ats-template-v1' into dev-duplicate

fix(resume-builder): keep share tokens out of URLs and stop automatic PDF renders

Share and editor links keep the token in the fragment, public API calls send it in a header, offline shared saves include a version so a stale tab cannot overwrite a newer one, and page count runs only when requested.

fix(resume-builder): My Resume home, section highlight, page limit, readable AI errors

- Resume builder now opens on My Resume: master resume at a glance (completeness, ATS checks, quality score), what to do next, tailored versions, all resumes
- The section being edited is highlighted as a whole in the preview (ATS and classic) and scrolled into view
- Page limit control (1-4 pages) in the preview toolbar and Templates tab, saved with the resume
- API errors are real Errors carrying the server's message (AI failures no longer show a generic text); network failures get a plain explanation instead of 'Failed to fetch'

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(resume-builder): one New resume flow, one Tailor tab, same My Resume page for bench sales

- New resume: upload a PDF/Word file, import from LinkedIn, start from scratch, or copy the master for a job/role/recruiter, in one dialog (and the first-time screen)
- Tailor replaces Variants + Tailor to Job: add a job, see the match, create a tailored copy that opens with the Job Match tools; versions can be opened, duplicated and deleted. Tailoring never edits the master
- Bench sales get the same My Resume page for each consultant
- A resume shared with any signed-in role (e.g. an employer) opens read-only; roles without a builder go back to the dashboard
- Job coverage recomputes once the saved resume has loaded and as it is edited

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(resume-builder): collapsible panels, full-screen preview, certification showcase, longer page limits

- Editor-only / split / preview-only layout, remembered in the browser
- Full-screen preview (Esc to exit) with zoom and the ATS text view
- Certification showcase on screen (badges, validity, verify link); exports stay plain text
- Certification fields: expires, credential ID, verification link, optional https badge image
- Page limit control: 1-4 plus 5-8 behind a menu

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Certification picker/showcase, one-step Tailor, page add/remove, customize panel, preview page navigator

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Employer resume dashboard + assign-to-recruiter; mobile fixes for full-screen preview

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Employer import passes the consultant in the query; Remove access button in the assign dialog

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Catalog search: send at most 80 characters and 20 results (the API now validates both)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge pull request #30 from jobfynder-admin/fix/resume-builder-uat

Resume builder: certifications, one-step tailor, page controls, customize, employer dashboard
